mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS rising (FEDFUNDS > previous month's value).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as it signals a strong labor market and reduced recession risks.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing below 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable demand environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns fail to rise despite concurrent GDPC1 growth and FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the INDPRO supply index over three months reduces inflationary pressures, leading to lower interest rates and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns remain negative despite sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle' regime (FEDFUNDS > 2%), a further rise in the federal funds rate predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates on equities.
failure_condition: 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances within the 'monetary tightening cycle' regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in job growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 creates optimism about labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns remain negative despite PAYEMS crossing above 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high supply growth (INDPRO) and weak demand (GDPC1 decline) creates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are positive despite high INDPRO and low GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime (high GDPC1 and low UNRATE), a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are positive despite GDPC1 dropping below previous quarter's level in the 'late-cycle expansion' regime.
